validationScope: Declarative examples for architectural evaluation; no runtime executor, official progression, numerical character option or gameplay authorization.
notAssumptions: No universal form stages, moon trigger, alignment change or loss of control
No default free Bloodline Class levels or XP penalties
No automatic class or inventory record deletion
No default resource refill or reset on transformation

sharedScenarios.given: A character earned a Class or Background feature and entered a form that suspends its use.
sharedScenarios.when: The effective profile is projected and later reverted.
expect: The earned grant and provenance persist
Applicability changes only for the authored interval
Reversion does not re-award the feature or reset its resources

sharedScenarios.given: An authored supernatural form resembles a native SRD monster.
expect: Only individually authored/authorized form grants are available
CR, monster HD, legendary actions, monster HP and proficiency bonus are not automatically imported

sharedScenarios.given: Two independently sourced temporary forms target the sole effective Species/Ancestry slot.
sharedScenarios.when: Both are simultaneously active without a precedence rule.
expect: No implicit first/last source wins
The conflict is recorded as unresolved until an authored rule or scoped DM decision resolves it

sharedScenarios.given: A character has expended slots or a tracked resource and gains/loses a form.
sharedScenarios.when: The resource becomes inaccessible or its displayed maximum changes.
expect: Spent quantities and occurrence identities remain historical
No automatic refilling, resetting, capping or refunding occurs
Over-cap and ongoing-effect behavior require explicitly authored policies

sharedScenarios.given: The DM authorizes a scoped alteration to a transformation restriction.
expect: First-party defaults remain unchanged
The ruling identifies authority, scope, target and effective decision
Untrusted client assertions cannot create grants or software permissions

sharedScenarios.given: A source replaces the full movement subsystem without supplying complete movement values.
sharedScenarios.when: The effective movement profile is projected.
expect: Unspecified affected movement slots are unresolved
The engine neither silently retains obsolete values nor infers values from a similarly named monster

cases.role: Primary progressive supernatural inheritance test; no form required

scenarios.given: A character inherits an authored draconic influence with no earned powers.
expect: Baseline Species and Ancestry stay authoritative
No automatic Dragon type, Dragonborn traits, breath weapon, or Sorcerer levels
Unmanifested potential does not become an active grant

scenarios.given: Two independently authored bloodline milestones have distinct prerequisite triggers.
scenarios.when: One milestone becomes eligible and is authorized.
expect: Only that milestone's selected feature becomes an earned grant
Its source, occurrence, choices and prerequisite evidence remain attributable
No automatic grants from the other milestone

scenarios.given: The character has a Dragonborn breath feature and independently earns a bloodline ability with a similar name.
expect: Do not merge their uses or grant identity based on similar names
Shared resources or incompatibility require an actual rule or a scoped ruling

scenarios.given: The character is a non-Sorcerer who gains draconic supernatural traits.
expect: No Class advancement, Sorcery Points or class-exclusive feature is inferred
Existing independent Class choices remain earned

scenarios.given: A source-specific rule suppresses a manifested supernatural trait without undoing a Class level.
expect: The trait's entitlement and progress history remain identifiable
Restoration and prerequisites are rechecked
No class-level penalty or automatic rollback is inferred

scenarios.given: An optional bloodline progression grants additional powers beyond normal Species and Class features.
expect: Acquisition terms or balancing rules must be authored
An unrestricted free parallel progression is not silently certified as balanced

cases.role: Primary persistent physiological effects, vulnerabilities and heterogeneous form policy test
cases.reference: Native selected monster.vampire, plus 3.5e vampire template (comparative only)

scenarios.given: A person has an authorized full-vampire influence in their normal appearance.
scenarios.when: No bat or mist alternate form is active.
expect: Persistent source-linked supernatural characteristics and weaknesses can be active
Underlying Species/Ancestry remains unless a separately authorized permanent reconstruction occurs
Original Class and Background entitlements are not erased by the influence

scenarios.given: An authored full-vampire rule changes effective type to Undead.
scenarios.when: The normal-form effective profile is projected.
expect: Creature-type targeting uses the explicitly authored effective classification
Underlying Species/Ancestry is not automatically replaced merely because effective type changed
Monster Undead statblock benefits are not automatically copied to the player character

scenarios.given: An authored vampire has a bat form with form-specific movement, speech and equipment handling.
expect: Only the authored effective slots are modified or replaced
Independent grants remain earned while use depends on the form policy
No blanket assumption that gear is dropped or inaccessible

scenarios.given: The same vampire has a mist form with broader action and manipulation restrictions.
expect: Actions, speaking and manipulating objects may be suspended by explicit form rules
The bat form's narrower policies are not silently copied
Inventory ownership and Class progression remain intact

scenarios.given: The vampire has source-defined sunlight weakness and a feeding dependency.
scenarios.when: The character is in normal or alternate form.
expect: Each exposure, timing and resource condition resolves under an authored rule
The influence does not gain monster regeneration or bite numbers by resemblance alone
A transformation does not erase previously tracked damage or resource spending

scenarios.given: Selected-native vampire and vampire spawn are distinct monster records.
scenarios.when: A player supernatural progression is considered.
expect: Full vampire, spawn and player-acquired vampire are not automatically equivalent
No CR, Hit Dice, legendary actions or monster Class progression is inherited
Specific vampire acquisition and balance remain open design decisions

cases.role: Primary temporary Species/Ancestry replacement and reversion test

scenarios.given: A Human has lycanthropy but no currently active wolf form.
expect: Underlying and effective baseline Species remain Human absent a separately authored modifier
Having the influence does not imply unlocked forms or involuntary shifting
Source/character history is preserved

scenarios.given: A Human with a legally unlocked wolf form performs an authorized transition.
expect: Wolf form temporarily replaces effective Species/Ancestry
Underlying Human remains authoritative
Old inherent grants are not automatically unioned with new form grants

scenarios.given: The same character has an independently authored hybrid form with a less restrictive replacement profile.
expect: Hybrid and full-wolf profiles can differ in weapon, speech, equipment and Class-feature applicability
No universal full Class-feature suspension is inferred

scenarios.given: One setting uses voluntary shifts and another has an authored forced trigger with separate player-agency rules.
expect: Triggering a change and controlling actions are separate policies
No universal full moon, involuntary check, alignment change or DM control

scenarios.given: Human underlying is permanently replaced by Elf during an active wolf form through an authorized Rite.
scenarios.when: The wolf form ends under a valid rule.
expect: Reversion uses the latest underlying Elf configuration
Superseded Human grants are not restored from an old snapshot
Independent Class/Background entitlements persist subject to new-form applicability

scenarios.given: The character shifts between wolf and normal form.
expect: The shift is an active temporary transformation, not supernatural-reconstruction origination
Only a separate permanent reconstruction event can change the authoritative baseline

cases.role: Primary optional powers, event-gated progression, and terminal baseline reconstruction test
cases.reference: BG3 Illithid powers and full-illithid paths (comparative only)

scenarios.given: An infected character chooses and earns an authored psionic feature.
expect: Source-qualified additional power is recorded
Underlying Species and Class remain unchanged
No compulsory final reconstruction or creature-type change is inferred

scenarios.given: A specific authorized event introduces partial physiological changes.
expect: Changes affect only the explicitly authored current slots and grants
The original authoritative Species remains in place until a completed reconstruction event
Partial transformation is not mechanically equivalent to terminal reconstruction

scenarios.given: An authored route permits complete reconstruction without partial transformation.
expect: A non-linear direct terminal transition is representable
The engine does not require intermediate stage IDs that the route does not specify

scenarios.given: An authored ceremorphosis process completes permanent replacement with a new Illithid Species/Ancestry.
scenarios.when: The terminal event is authorized and completed.
expect: Underlying Species/Ancestry is replaced and earlier inherent grants are superseded as defined
Previous underlying state remains historical but not effective
Effective creature type is resolved according to its authored rule
No automatically invented monster abilities

scenarios.given: The completed illithid profile explicitly retains a previously earned Class ability but replaces other active systems.
scenarios.when: The full character profile is projected.
expect: Retained Class entitlement remains available where authorized
Other affected capabilities follow their replacement or suspension policies
Class levels and inventory history are not implicitly deleted

scenarios.given: A character is temporarily transformed during an authorized permanent ceremorphosis event.
expect: The new underlying baseline becomes authoritative
What happens to the temporary form must follow explicit interaction/precedence rules
Reversion must not resurrect the old baseline
